raw.rationale: Testosterone is a weak antiproliferative androgen-receptor agonist in vitro, and PRISM profiling of AR agonists typically shows selective sensitivity only in AR-dependent prostate and some breast cancer models, with little lineage-selective killing among the listed non-prostate lineages at 2.5 µM. Given low base rates and no strong published PRISM selectivity for these lineages, probabilities are near the lower end of the 0.2–2.5% range.
